usr_id.description: Whose factor this is — removed with the user

type.description: The factor's name, e.g. totp. Several rows of one type are one factor with several secrets, as backup codes are

label.description: What the user called it, so several of a kind stay distinguishable

data.description: The factor's own secret as JSON — never read by auth, only by the module that wrote it

last_used.description: Null until it has proved something once
